verifyNote: Word lists, glosses, pinyin, grammar points and page numbers cross-checked page by page against the printed HSK Standard Course 2 (北京语言大学出版社) — the 目录 and the 词语总表/专有名词/超纲词/旧字新词 indexes. Every word, lesson title, page number, star flag and grammar point matches the printed index. 长 (zhǎng, L13 "to grow") is intentionally omitted: its string 长 is already introduced at L4 as cháng ("long"). Over-syllabus words are flagged "star": true. Sentences are authored from words already taught (checked cumulatively by tools/check.mjs) and cover each lesson's grammar points.

lessons.title: 九月去北京旅游最好
lessons.titlePinyin: Jiǔ yuè qù Běijīng lǚyóu zuì hǎo
lessons.titleEn: September is the best time to visit Beijing
lessons.topic: Talking about travel plans and what you like doing

words.gloss: to travel; to take a trip
to want to; will; be going to

grammar.title: The auxiliary verb 要
grammar.tip: 要 before a verb expresses wanting or intending to do something — "want to" or "be going to": 我要去北京。 = I'm going to go to Beijing.

grammar.title: The adverb of degree 最
grammar.tip: 最 marks the top of a scale — "most" or "-est": 最好 = best, 最大 = biggest.

grammar.title: Expressions of approximate numbers: 几 and 多
grammar.tip: 几 stands for an unspecified small number ("a few / several"); a round number followed by 多 means "and then some" — 十多个 = ten-odd.

sentences.en: I want to travel to Beijing.

sentences.pinyin: Jiǔ yuè qù Běijīng lǚyóu zuì hǎo.
sentences.en: September is the best time to travel to Beijing.
He likes playing football the most.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhè běn shū hěn hǎo.
sentences.en: I think this book is very good.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de xīn yīfu.
Huāhua hěn xiǎo, tā xǐhuan yùndòng.
sentences.en: Huahua is small, and it likes to move around.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yào mǎi jǐ běn xīn shū.
sentences.en: I want to buy a few new books.

sentences.pinyin: Zhèr yǒu shí duō gè rén.
sentences.en: There are more than ten people here.

lessons.title: 我每天六点起床
lessons.titlePinyin: Wǒ měi tiān liù diǎn qǐchuáng
lessons.titleEn: I get up at six every day
lessons.topic: Daily routine, health and being unwell

words.gloss: to come out; to go out
to get up; to get out of bed
to fall ill; to be sick
to have or take a rest
to leave hospital; to be discharged

grammar.title: Questions using 是不是
grammar.tip: 是不是 makes a yes-no question that expects confirmation — put it before the part you are checking: 你是不是生病了？ = You're sick, aren't you?

grammar.title: The pronoun 每
grammar.tip: 每 means "every / each" and needs a measure word: 每天 = every day, 每个人 = everyone. It often pairs with 都.

grammar.title: The interrogative pronoun 多
grammar.tip: 多 before an adjective asks about degree: 多大？ = how old/big?, 多高？ = how tall?

sentences.pinyin: Měi gè rén dōu hěn máng.
Tā měi gè xīngqī qù pǎobù.

sentences.en: I get up at six in the morning.

sentences.pinyin: Nǐ shì bu shì shēngbìng le?

sentences.en: When you're sick you should take medicine.

sentences.pinyin: Tā shì bu shì chūyuàn le?
sentences.en: Has he been discharged from hospital?

sentences.pinyin: Tā zǎoshang bā diǎn chū qù.
sentences.en: He goes out at eight in the morning.

sentences.pinyin: Tā hěn gāo, yě hěn máng.
sentences.en: He is tall and also very busy.
I don't have time to rest.

lessons.title: 左边那个红色的是我的
lessons.titlePinyin: Zuǒbian nàge hóngsè de shì wǒ de
lessons.titleEn: The red one on the left is mine
lessons.topic: Colors, describing and pointing out things

words.gloss: to send; to deliver; to give (a gift)
(after a verb) to have a quick …; once

grammar.title: The 的 phrase
grammar.tip: X + 的 with the noun left off means "the X one": 红色的 = the red one, 我的 = mine.

grammar.title: The numeral-measure 一下
grammar.tip: Verb + 一下 softens a verb to "do a bit / have a quick …": 看一下 = take a look.

grammar.title: The modal adverb 真
grammar.tip: 真 before an adjective voices the speaker's reaction — "really / so": 真好！ = so good! It states a feeling, unlike the neutral 很.

sentences.zh: 左边那个红色的是我的。
sentences.pinyin: Zuǒbian nàge hóngsè de shì wǒ de.
sentences.en: The red one on the left is mine.
Take a look at this watch.
I drink milk in the morning.
The shop is next to your home.
This cup costs a thousand yuan.
I'll take him to the hospital.

sentences.zh: 我喜欢红的，不喜欢粉的。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan hóng de, bù xǐhuan fěn de.

lessons.title: 这个工作是他帮我介绍的
lessons.titlePinyin: Zhège gōngzuò shì tā bāng wǒ jièshào de
lessons.titleEn: He recommended me for this job

words.gloss: to meet; to pick up; to receive

grammar.title: The 是……的 construction: emphasizing the agent
grammar.tip: For an action already completed, 是……的 highlights who, how or when it happened: 是他帮我介绍的 = it was he who introduced me.

grammar.title: Indicating time with ……的时候
grammar.tip: X 的时候 means "when X / at the time of X": 我小的时候 = when I was young.

grammar.title: The adverb of time 已经
grammar.tip: 已经 means "already" and usually pairs with 了 at the end: 他已经走了。

sentences.zh: 这个工作是他帮我介绍的。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège gōngzuò shì tā bāng wǒ jièshào de.
sentences.en: He recommended me for this job.
It was my mom who introduced it.

sentences.zh: 我小的时候非常喜欢运动。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎo de shíhou fēicháng xǐhuan yùndòng.
sentences.en: When I was little I really liked sports.
He'll come to pick me up in the evening.

words.gloss: (measure word for clothes and matters) piece
to prepare; to intend to; to plan

grammar.title: The adverb 就
grammar.tip: 就 here signals a quick, decisive choice — "then just …": 就买这件吧 = then just buy this one.

grammar.title: The modal adverb 还 (1)
grammar.tip: 还 adds "also / in addition": 我还要一个 = I want one more as well.

grammar.title: The adverbial modifier 有点儿
grammar.tip: 有点儿 + adjective means "a little (too) …", usually about something you're not happy with: 有点儿贵 = a bit expensive.

sentences.en: These clothes are a little big.
I still want to drink coffee.

sentences.zh: 这个菜很好吃，鱼也不错。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège cài hěn hǎochī, yú yě búcuò.
sentences.en: This dish is delicious, and the fish is good too.

grammar.title: The interrogative pronoun 怎么
grammar.tip: 怎么 asks "how" or "how come": 怎么走？ = how do I get there?, 你怎么不吃了？ = how come you've stopped eating?

grammar.title: Reduplication of measure words
grammar.tip: Doubling a measure word means "every single one": 个个都好 = each one is good; 天天 = every day.

grammar.title: The conjunctions 因为……，所以……
grammar.tip: 因为 gives the reason and 所以 the result; Chinese keeps both halves: 因为下雨，所以我不去。

sentences.zh: 因为下雨，所以我不去打篮球。
sentences.pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ wǒ bú qù dǎ lánqiú.
sentences.en: Because it's raining, I'm not going to play basketball.
I like to eat mutton noodles.

sentences.pinyin: Mén wài yǒu yí gè zìxíngchē.
sentences.en: There's a bike outside the door.

sentences.zh: 因为我很忙，所以没有时间游泳。
sentences.pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ hěn máng, suǒyǐ méiyǒu shíjiān yóuyǒng.
sentences.en: Because I'm busy, I don't have time to swim.
Every one of these dishes is delicious.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jiějie hěn xǐhuan dǎ lánqiú.
sentences.en: My elder sister loves playing basketball.

lessons.title: 你家离公司远吗
lessons.titlePinyin: Nǐ jiā lí gōngsī yuǎn ma
lessons.titleEn: Do you live far from your company
lessons.topic: Distance, getting around and how long it takes

words.gloss: to walk; to go; to leave

grammar.title: The modal adverb 还 (2)
grammar.tip: 还 also means "still" — an action or state that keeps going: 他还在工作。 = He is still working.

grammar.title: The adverb of time 就
grammar.tip: 就 stresses that something happens soon, or sooner than expected: 他六点就到了。 = He arrived as early as six.

grammar.title: The verb 离
grammar.tip: 离 states the distance between two places: A 离 B 远 = A is far from B. 我家离公司很近。

grammar.title: The modal particle 呢
grammar.tip: 呢 softens a question about a topic already in play, or asks "what about …?": 你呢？ = and you?; 他在做什么呢？

sentences.pinyin: Nǐ jiā lí gōngsī yuǎn ma?
sentences.en: Is your home far from the company?

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jiā lí gōngsī bù yuǎn.
sentences.en: My home isn't far from the company.

sentences.zh: 坐公共汽车要一个小时。
sentences.pinyin: Zuò gōnggòngqìchē yào yí gè xiǎoshí.
sentences.en: It takes an hour by bus.
There's no one in the classroom.
Is he still in the classroom?

sentences.pinyin: Tā liù diǎn jiù dào gōngsī le.
sentences.en: He got to the company at six.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào qù gōngsī de lù.
sentences.en: I know the way to the company.

lessons.title: 让我想想再告诉你
lessons.titlePinyin: Ràng wǒ xiǎngxiang zài gàosù nǐ
lessons.titleEn: Let me think about it and I'll tell you later
lessons.topic: Making plans, ordering and putting things off

words.gloss: to let; to allow; to have (sb do sth)

grammar.title: The question ……，好吗
grammar.tip: Add 好吗？ to a suggestion to ask for agreement — "…, OK?": 我们一起去，好吗？

grammar.title: The adverb 再
grammar.tip: 再 means "again / more" for something not yet done, or "(do sth) later": 明天再说 = talk about it again tomorrow.

grammar.title: Pivotal sentences
grammar.tip: One noun is the object of the first verb and the subject of the second: 让我想想 = let me think; 老师让我们看书。

grammar.title: Reduplication of verbs
grammar.tip: Doubling a verb makes the action brief and casual — "have a little …": 想想 = think it over a bit; 看看 = take a look.

sentences.pinyin: Ràng wǒ xiǎngxiang zài gàosù nǐ.
sentences.en: Let me think it over and I'll tell you later.

sentences.pinyin: Fúwùyuán, wǒ yào yí gè cài.

sentences.en: These clothes are a little expensive.

sentences.zh: 我喜欢白的，他喜欢黑的。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan bái de, tā xǐhuan hēi de.
sentences.en: I like white, he likes black.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu hěn duō shìqing yào zuò.
sentences.en: I have a lot of things to do.
Let's talk about it again tomorrow.

lessons.title: 题太多，我没做完
lessons.titlePinyin: Tí tài duō, wǒ méi zuò wán
lessons.titleEn: There were too many questions; I didn't finish all of them

words.gloss: to go to work; to be on duty

grammar.title: Complements of result
grammar.tip: A result complement after a verb says how it turned out: 做完 = finish doing, 听懂 = understand (by listening), 做错 = do wrong.

grammar.title: The preposition 从
grammar.tip: 从 marks a starting point in space or time: 从这儿走 = go from here; 从九点开始。

grammar.title: 第- indicating order
grammar.tip: 第 before a number makes an ordinal: 第一 = first, 第三 = third.

sentences.pinyin: Tí tài duō, wǒ méiyǒu zuò wán.
sentences.en: There are too many questions; I didn't finish them.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ cóng jiǔ diǎn kāishǐ shàngbān.
Nǐ zhège tí zuò cuò le.

sentences.en: I hope it won't rain tomorrow.

lessons.title: 别找了，手机在桌子上呢
lessons.titlePinyin: Bié zhǎo le, shǒujī zài zhuōzi shàng ne
lessons.titleEn: Stop looking for your cell phone; it's on the desk
lessons.topic: Finding things, helping and what's happening now

words.gloss: (be) in the process of; right now

grammar.title: The imperative 不要……了 / 别……了
grammar.tip: 别 or 不要 + verb + 了 tells someone to stop what they're doing: 别找了 = stop looking; 不要说了。

grammar.title: The preposition 对
grammar.tip: 对 points an action or attitude at someone: 对我说 = say to me; 他对我很好。

sentences.zh: 别找了，手机在桌子上呢。
sentences.pinyin: Bié zhǎo le, shǒujī zài zhuōzi shàng ne.
sentences.en: Stop looking, your phone is on the table.
He is very good to me.
My older brother is washing the car.

sentences.pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ chī le yí gè jīdàn.
sentences.en: I ate an egg this morning.

lessons.title: 他比我大三岁
lessons.titlePinyin: Tā bǐ wǒ dà sān suì
lessons.titleEn: He is three years older than me
lessons.topic: Comparing people and describing who they are

grammar.title: A verb (phrase) used as an attributive modifier
grammar.tip: A verb phrase + 的 describes a noun, like a relative clause: 说话的人 = the person who's speaking; 唱歌的孩子。

grammar.title: The 比 sentence (1)
grammar.tip: A 比 B + adjective compares them — "A is more … than B": 他比我大。 Don't add 很 or 太 to the adjective.

grammar.title: The auxiliary verb 可能
grammar.tip: 可能 before a verb marks a guess — "may / might / probably": 他可能不来了。

sentences.en: This one is cheaper than that one.

sentences.pinyin: Chànggē de rén shì wǒ péngyou.
sentences.en: The person singing is my friend.

sentences.zh: 那个男的是老师，女的是学生。
sentences.pinyin: Nàge nán de shì lǎoshī, nǚ de shì xuésheng.
sentences.en: The man is a teacher, the woman is a student.
Last year I went to Beijing.
The shop is on the right.

sentences.zh: 唱歌的孩子可能是他儿子。
sentences.pinyin: Chànggē de háizi kěnéng shì tā érzi.
sentences.en: The singing child might be his son.

lessons.title: 你穿得太少了
lessons.titlePinyin: Nǐ chuān de tài shǎo le

words.gloss: (after a verb/adjective, introduces a degree complement)

grammar.title: Complements of degree
grammar.tip: 得 links a verb or adjective to a comment on its degree: 穿得太少 = wear too little; 说得很好 = speak very well.

grammar.title: The 比 sentence (2)
grammar.tip: Put the amount of difference after the adjective: 他比我大三岁 = three years older; 便宜一点儿 = a bit cheaper.

sentences.pinyin: Nǐ chuān de tài shǎo le.
Tā bǐ wǒ dà sān suì.
sentences.en: He is three years older than me.

sentences.zh: 这个比那个便宜一点儿。
sentences.en: This one is a bit cheaper than that.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jiā lí zhèr hěn jìn.
sentences.en: My home is close to here.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi chuān de hěn shǎo.
sentences.en: My younger brother wears too little.

sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài shì shí diǎn líng wǔ fēn.

lessons.title: 门开着呢
lessons.topic: States of things and giving directions

words.gloss: (after a verb, marks an ongoing state)
to hold; to take; to bring

grammar.title: The structural particle 着
grammar.tip: Verb + 着 marks an ongoing state that stays put: 门开着 = the door is (standing) open; 拿着书 = holding a book.

grammar.title: The rhetorical question 不是……吗
grammar.tip: 不是……吗？ states the obvious as a question — "isn't it that …?": 你不是有手机吗？ = don't you have a phone (so use it)!

grammar.title: The preposition 往
grammar.tip: 往 gives the direction of movement: 往前走 = go forward; 往右边走 = go to the right.

sentences.pinyin: Tā shǒu lǐ ná zhe yì běn shū.
sentences.en: He's holding a book in his hand.

sentences.pinyin: Nǐ bú shì yǒu shǒujī ma?
sentences.en: Don't you have a cell phone?

sentences.pinyin: Wǎng qián zǒu jiù dào lùkǒu le.
sentences.en: Go straight ahead and you'll reach the crossing.

sentences.pinyin: Yáng Xiàoxiao zài bīnguǎn děng nǐ.
sentences.en: Yang Xiaoxiao is waiting for you at the hotel.

lessons.title: 你看过那个电影吗
lessons.titlePinyin: Nǐ kàn guò nàge diànyǐng ma
lessons.topic: Past experiences and weighing pros and cons

grammar.title: The structural particle 过
grammar.tip: Verb + 过 says something has been experienced at least once: 我看过那个电影 = I've seen that movie before.

grammar.title: The conjunctions 虽然……，但是……
grammar.tip: 虽然 concedes a point and 但是 gives the contrasting main idea; Chinese keeps both: 虽然很贵，但是很好。

grammar.title: The complement of frequency 次
grammar.tip: 次 counts how many times an action happens, placed after the verb: 去过一次 = have been once; 看了两次。

sentences.pinyin: Nǐ kàn guò nàge diànyǐng ma?
Wǒ qù guò Běijīng liǎng cì.
Suīrán hěn guì, dànshì hěn hǎo.

sentences.zh: 虽然下雨，但是我们还去玩儿。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán xiàyǔ, dànshì wǒmen hái qù wánr.
sentences.en: Although it's raining, we still go out to play.

lessons.title: 新年就要到了
lessons.topic: The New Year, the calendar and things about to happen

grammar.title: Indicating the state of an action: 要……了
grammar.tip: 要……了 says something is about to happen: 要下雨了 = it's going to rain; 新年就要到了。

grammar.title: The 都……了 construction
grammar.tip: 都……了 stresses that a point has already been reached — "already": 都十点了 = it's already ten; 都走了 = everyone's already left.

sentences.en: The New Year is almost here.

sentences.pinyin: Dōu shí diǎn le, dàjiā dōu zǒu le.
sentences.en: It's already ten o'clock; everyone has left.
I'm going to the station to buy tickets.
Today is even colder than yesterday.

sentences.zh: 都新年了，火车站人很多。
sentences.pinyin: Dōu xīnnián le, huǒchēzhàn rén hěn duō.
sentences.en: It's already New Year; the station is crowded.
